# A panel the program builds at run time holds a label and an instance of a
# component, each of which a test indexes, and reads a context it hands the
# instance.
#
# fyne and gtk4 listed every id the record held that a test indexes in the
# Model's map of widget copies, the instance among them, whose record is no
# widget: the program did not build. A nested instance takes its own root out
# of the Model's maps as it is destroyed.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import i18n "sngl:i18n"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// A label in the active locale's language.
func tagged(name string) => "{name} ({i18n.locale})"

// A chip counting its own taps.
component chip(name string) ui.node {
    var taps = 0

    ui.button #face(text=tagged(name), @click { taps += 1 })
}

component shelf ui.node {
    var rows = [["a", "b"], ["c"]]
    var shown = true

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #toggle(text="toggle", @click { shown = !shown })
        if shown {
            for var row = rows {
                ui.hbox {
                    for var name = row {
                        ui.hbox {
                            ui.text #label(value=tagged(name))
                            chip #item(name=name)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    shelf()
}

func testAChipOfARow(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    t.assert(c.label[1][0] != null)
    t.assert(c.item[0][1] != null)
    c.item[0][1].face.click()
    t.assert(c.item[0][1].taps == 1)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.item[0][1] == null)
}
